title: The Knot Task Overdue Hotspots
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:checklist task_bucket=* task_state=* overdue=*
| stats sum(eval(if(overdue="yes",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by task_bucket
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending overdue tasks backlog by task bucket for planning workloads.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside planning workloads.
implementation: Mark each `event:checklist` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `task_bucket`.
visualization: Table of task bucket with pending overdue tasks counts.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights where unfinished overdue tasks are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in planning workloads.
